meta.title: About · המשך תנועה
meta.description: A home for combat veterans after their service: regular meetings built on movement, community and direction, and local community centers on the way.

hero.title: A home for combat veterans after their service
hero.body: We're an Israeli nonprofit that runs regular, structured activity so that men and women who served in combat roles have a place to meet, move, find direction and succeed in life.

why.title: Here for good
body: The need for a team, for movement and for direction doesn't end when your military service does.
So we didn't build a program with an end date. We're a place that stays: come at any point, and come back whenever you like.

direction.title: Local community centers, nationwide
body: Together with local municipalities, we're building a new nationwide network of centers, only for discharged combat veterans.
Our vision: that every combat veteran in Israel doesn't just return home, but rises.
direction.start: Next: the first center, a pilot that will grow into a national network. Today's meetings are the beginning.

centers.title: A veterans’ club
centers.body: A place for conversation, connection and a community of veterans.

centers.title: Classes and workshops
centers.body: From yoga and CrossFit to ice baths: a healthy, energetic new start.

centers.title: Life skills and leadership
centers.body: A 12-session group program with practical workshops and real-world tools for civilian life.

today.title: What we do today
today.lead: Regular meetings. Every meeting is posted on the calendar.

items.title: Friday mornings
items.body: Three times a month at Holmes Place in Modi'in: a workout, coffee and snacks, and a guest talk.

items.title: Bonfire evenings and more
items.body: Evenings and special meetings, posted on the calendar.

items.title: Steady
items.body: Structured meetings, every month, over time. Not a one-off event.

items.title: Open
items.body: For every combat veteran, however long it's been since discharge. You don't need to know anyone.

items.title: Moving
items.body: Every Friday meeting starts with a workout built for every fitness level.

items.title: As equals
items.body: No ranks, no roll call. And it isn't a talking circle: everyone shares only what they want to.

name.title: About our name
name.body: {org} means “keep moving”: in body, and in life. In English we go by Moving Forward. It’s also our slogan: keep moving with us.

people.title: The people behind it
people.body: A team, a board and volunteers who make the meetings happen.

closing.title: The best way to get to know us: come
